notes: Sources: the 13 usable files, all pages of the Stanford Faculty Handbook (Wayback captures 2018-03-11; pages 'Last updated September 1, 2017'), the governing document for the Academic Council (tenure line) and Medical Center professoriates; read as in force on 2018-02-24. 2018_02, 2018_03 and 2018_10 are chapter/section index pages with summaries; 2018_03 holds the section 3.5 introduction (disability-benefit application rule), 2018_02 the chapter's statement that leaves are at the Chairs' or Deans' discretion.

The saved CFRA (2026_02, Gov. Code 12945.2) and PDL (2026_03, Gov. Code 12945) texts are 2022-2023 amended versions; the lengths relied on (12 workweeks; four months) match what the handbook states for 2017-18.

Birth-parent chain: PDL up to 4 months (c1), with FMLA (c6) concurrent, STD insurance (c3, from week 2), the University pregnancy supplement to full salary (c2, within c1) and the general disability supplement (c4, concurrent with c2), all within the reduced-teaching quarters (c10, discretionary, quarter of birth and/or the next) → CFRA bonding leave 12 workweeks (c7, consecutive_after c1, S1a) with FTD 6 weeks (c8, concurrent_with c7) and the University FTD top-up to full salary (c9, within c8) → childcare leave without salary up to 1 year (c12, discretionary, consecutive_after c10 and c1; or part-time c13 in_lieu_of c12). School of Medicine clinical relief (c11, 90 days after PDL) is scope-limited.

Non-birth-parent chain: FMLA (c6) and CFRA (c7) together, a total of 12 workweeks (c7 concurrent_with c6 for nonbirth), with FTD 6 weeks (c8, concurrent_with c7) and the University top-up (c9, within c8); reduced-teaching quarter (c10, discretionary, 1 quarter) → childcare leave up to 1 year (c12, consecutive_after c10).

Path choice (U8): FTD and short-term disability come through either the Stanford VDI Plan or California SDI; the documents do not say which a faculty member is in. Both are coded once, payer insurance_plan (M1, delivery not stated); the SDI seven-day waiting period (UIC 2627(b)) is applied to c3; the VDI plan's terms are not saved.

Tenure clock: PDL, reduced teaching and short-term disability do not extend the clock (2.1.4(2)c; 2.1.5 table), except by Provost exception (c18); the new-parent extension (c15) is one year per birth or adoption. The appointment-term extension that accompanies clock extensions 'will ordinarily be granted' (2.1.5, 2.5.4); recorded in c15's entitlement_note rather than as a component.

Stale cross-references inside 2018_11: it points to 'Section 3.5.3' for childcare leave (now 3.5.6) and 'Section 3.5.2' for reduced teaching (now 3.5.5); 2018_03 points to 'section 2.1.D(2)' (now 2.1.4(2), saved).

Documents cited but not saved: Stanford Voluntary Disability Insurance (VDI) Plan; Long Term Disability FAQs for Faculty; benefits instructions at cardinalatwork.stanford.edu; handbook 3.1 General Policies Applicable to Leaves and Other Absences From Campus, 3.2 Sabbatical Leave, 3.4 Period of Pure Research Leave; Chapter 4 Statement on Appointment and Tenure; Chapter 7 Leave Policies for Academic Staff-Teaching (another group); forms: Application for Reduced Teaching or Clinical Duties for New Faculty Parents, standard leave request form (Appendix A), Recommendation for Amendment of Professorial Appointment (Appendix C), new-parent tenure extension form.

Health insurance: during FML the University continues its contributions; on full leave without salary (childcare leave) the faculty member pays the University's share; partial-leave contributions depend on percent time (3.5.2, 3.5.6). Not coded as components.
